Live Junk Free tears all of it down and hauls it away in one visit. Around the Four Corners and Brooklin’s older streets, it’s a garage or a deck that’s finally past its structural life, torn down and cleared with the same care as anything else on an established property. And out on the Ashburn and Myrtle concessions, it’s fence demolition, shed teardowns and concrete removal on larger rural lots. The 700+ five-star Google reviews behind Live Junk Free come from every one of those yards — a demolition crew that tore it down safely, kept kids and pets clear of the work zone, and left the space swept the same day.

blocks.text: DEMOLITION FAQ
Demolition Services in Whitby — What to Know Before You Book

items.q: How much does demolition cost in Whitby?
a: Price depends on the structure — a fence section or trampoline is a small job; a full above ground pool, garage or concrete pad costs more given the size, material and crew time involved. The exact figure is confirmed free at the walkthrough and covers teardown, haul-away and disposal together.

items.q: Do you handle pool demolition, or just removal?
a: Both. Above ground pool demolition includes tearing down the frame, removing the liner, and clearing any surrounding decking, with everything hauled away and disposed of or recycled properly.

items.q: Can you tear down a shed, garage or deck safely with kids or pets around?
a: Yes — it’s how we run every job by default. Work zones stay contained, debris and tools stay out of reach, and the crew paces the demolition around a household that’s still living its normal day around the work.

items.q: What's involved in concrete or flooring demolition?
a: The pad, walkway or patio gets broken up with the right equipment for its thickness and reinforcement, then hauled off in pieces small enough to load safely. The site is left level and cleared, ready for whatever’s replacing it.

items.q: Do you remove hot tubs and jacuzzis as part of demolition, or is that separate?
a: Both are handled — hot tub and jacuzzi demolition involves draining, disconnecting and cutting the shell apart before hauling, using the same process as our dedicated hot tub removal service.

items.q: Can you demolish a playset, swing set or trampoline in one visit?
a: Yes, and most single-structure jobs like these finish in under an hour. The frame gets disassembled, netting or fabric removed, and everything hauled away the same visit.

items.q: Can demolition happen the same day I call?
a: Often, yes. Trucks run Whitby daily, 6AM to 11PM, seven days a week, so a morning call frequently means an afternoon demolition — call +1 647 922 5865 for today’s real availability.

items.q: What happens to the materials after demolition?
a: Metal components go to recyclers, and wood, concrete and other materials are disposed of responsibly. Nothing goes to landfill that has a better destination.

items.q: Why are your demolition rates lower than the bigger companies?
a: No franchise royalty built into the quote — Live Junk Free is local and independent, with our own insured crew and trucks. The identical demolition job, handled just as carefully, simply costs less.
